title: Dutch Defense: Leningrad Variation
line: Black puts its bishop on the long diagonal and gets ready to push the king's pawn.

steps.text: The Dutch, and White gets ready to put its bishop on the long diagonal.
Push the pawn on g7 one square. Your bishop goes to the long diagonal too.

also.e7e6: That leads to the other setups, also sound. This lesson goes on with the pawn on g7.

steps.text: Put the bishop on the long diagonal. Once your knight moves, it aims at White's pawn on d4.
Castle, to get your king to safety.
Move the pawn in front of your queen one square. It gets a pawn push to e5 ready.
Step the queen out to e8. It backs up the push.

also.c7c6: That is a main line too. This lesson goes on with the queen.

steps.text: Now push the pawn in front of your king two squares, into the center.

steps.after: Black has pawns side by side in the center. White strikes back at once at the one on f5.

summary: The bishop goes to the long diagonal, the queen backs up a center pawn push, and Black gets two pawns side by side.
